schema.title: Client bookkeeping settings
schema.description: Settings for one business whose books you keep. Submit it once per business, and again whenever something changes.

questions.label: Xero organisation name (exactly as it appears in Xero)
Is this business registered for GST?
Who reviews this business's bills? (leave blank to use the default reviewer)
Bills above this amount need the business owner's approval (leave blank to use the default)
Who approves bills at the business? (name)
Coding notes for the AI (e.g. "Bunnings is always 449 Repairs and Maintenance")
Run the ledger checks on this business’s Xero file?
Who follows up its findings? (leave blank to use the practice default, then the reviewer)
Does this business lodge a taxable payments annual report (TPAR)? (building and construction, cleaning, courier, road freight, IT, security and investigation services)
Suspense or clearing account codes to watch, separated by commas (optional; accounts named suspense, clearing or uncoded are watched anyway)
